headline: Blackbeard's last battle
post_facts: He tucked burning fuses under his hat
Virginia sent two sloops after him
He fell near Ocracoke Island, North Carolina

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in seventeen eighteen... the pirate Blackbeard met his end.

scenes.label: Blackbeard
scenes.caption: Engraving by Benjamin Cole, 1724
scenes.title: Burning fuses under his hat
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] He tucked burning fuses under his hat, to frighten his enemies.

scenes.label: sloops sent from Virginia to hunt him
scenes.text: [calmly] Virginia's governor sent two sloops after him, led by Lieutenant Robert Maynard.

scenes.label: Ocracoke, North Carolina
scenes.caption: Painting by J. L. G. Ferris, 1920
scenes.title: A fight hand to hand
scenes.text: [gravely] Near Ocracoke Island, the crews fought hand to hand... and Blackbeard fell.

scenes.title: His ship was found centuries later
scenes.text: [softly] Centuries later, divers found his flagship off North Carolina.

scenes.title: Would you have joined his crew?
scenes.text: [gently] Would you have joined his crew?
